lines.quote: Designed a beamforming algorithm for the receive chain of an 8-element X-band synthetic aperture radar antenna.
Wrote embedded DSP firmware in C for a TI TMS320C6678 multi-core processor, handling real-time data reduction from an optical detector array operating at 200 MS/s.
Built and maintained a Python-based data processing toolkit for post-flight analysis of instrument telemetry.
Maintained with pytest and used across Aurinko's Espoo and Oulu offices.
Kallavesi University of Technology (formerly Nuuksio Institute of Technology), 2007
Participated in flight qualification and acceptance testing campaigns for two airborne instrument payloads delivered to EORA (2012 and 2018)
Designed a miniaturised signal chain for a CubeSat imager payload
